overview_description.description:
Scheduling Wiz helps to manage appointments and customers. With scheduling wiz you can publish your employees schedule via website and enable online appointments booking.
 
Scheduling Wiz is ideal schedule management software and CRM for dentists, beauty saloons, fitness centers, medical clinics, and other small businesses that set up customer appointments every day.
